note: Predictions originate from this desk's own lines; they are not bookmaker offers and not OLBG tipster endorsements. Confidence bands: High = implied probability >= 70%, Medium = 60-69%, Low = below 60%. The requested price window is -250 to +10,000 (American). Lines shorter than -250 are held at the -250 boundary and flagged. Every prediction links to the official source used to confirm the fixture; where current form, team news or injuries could not be confirmed from an official source at capture time, that fact is stated in the text and the row is flagged rather than invented.

pricing.formula: If p >= 0.50: American price = -100 * p / (1 - p). If p < 0.50: American price = 100 * (1 - p) / p.
